about: Every frame of the military complex board as its own PNG at native size, with its zoom and a caption. board.png is the sheet; the 3x copies on it are nearest-neighbour copies of the *_plan.png frames.

A  Hangar yard destroyed at zoom 1 (R1's language: scorch, craters, the main building roofless, heaps, the fence half down; no fire)
A  Hangar yard whole at the planning zoom 0.35 (about 0.8 px per metre: the planes' floor holds the marker rule above the map's 0.7)
A  Hangar yard destroyed at the planning zoom 0.35
A  Hangar yard whole at zoom 2, the camera's closest (4 px per metre)
A  Hangar yard destroyed at zoom 2
A  Hangar yard turned by its heading (about 51 degrees clockwise), baked already turned: the light and the shadows stay the map's
